about: A self-hosted app for tracking work hours across projects and clients.

prs.title: Bulk entry can add a slot right after another one
prs.broken: With 09:00 to 12:00 already logged, adding 12:00 to 17:00 for that day failed with an error, because an entry that only touched the new slot counted as an overlap.
prs.changed: Bulk entry now only refuses real overlaps, the same rule manual entries already follow.
prs.matters: People can fill in a normal split work day in one go.

prs.title: The Quote PDF designer is back in the sidebar
prs.broken: After a menu redesign, the admin sidebar only linked the invoice PDF designer. The quote designer could only be reached by typing its address.
prs.changed: The sidebar has separate links for invoice and quote PDFs again, each highlighted on its own page.
prs.matters: Admins can find and edit their quote layout without knowing a hidden address.

prs.title: Report exports now apply the filters you picked
prs.broken: The CSV and Excel exports ignored the client, task, billable, source and tag filters on the form, so an export for one client could include another client's hours.
prs.changed: Both exports now apply every filter on the form, the same way the report on screen does.
prs.matters: Invoices and timesheets built from an export only contain the hours that were asked for.

prs.title: Invoices from many time entries no longer fail on PostgreSQL
prs.broken: Making an invoice from about a hundred or more time entries crashed on PostgreSQL, because the list of entry ids was too long for its column.
prs.changed: The column now holds text of any length, with a database migration.
prs.matters: Teams on PostgreSQL can invoice a busy month in one go.

prs.title: Nearest rounding no longer drops half-interval entries
prs.broken: With nearest rounding, a time entry exactly halfway rounded to the even step, so a 15 minute task on 30 minute rounding was stored as zero.
prs.matters: Short tasks are no longer lost from timesheets and invoices.
